summary:
Project Summary – SUPER-NOVA
Our project, “The Lonely Explorer: Perseverance’s Mars Adventure,” is an educational digital book about NASA’s Perseverance rover and its mission on Mars. We developed an illustrated story that combines scientific facts with creative storytelling to make space exploration easier and more exciting to understand.

The book introduces Perseverance’s journey in Jezero Crater, its companion Ingenuity helicopter, Ingenuity’s 72 successful flights, and the rover’s collection of rock samples for future scientific research. It also includes real Mars images and information based on NASA’s official resources.

Our project addresses the challenge of making complex space science understandable and engaging, especially for young readers. By combining storytelling, visuals, and reliable scientific information, we help readers learn about Mars exploration in an enjoyable way.

This project is important because it inspires curiosity about science, technology, and space exploration while showing how robotic missions help humanity understand other worlds and investigate the possibility of ancient life on Mars.
details:
Our project is an educational digital book called “The Lonely Explorer: Perseverance’s Mars Adventure.” It tells the story of NASA’s Perseverance rover and explains its scientific mission on Mars.

The book works by combining storytelling, real Mars photographs, and scientific information. It introduces Perseverance’s exploration of Jezero Crater, the Ingenuity helicopter and its 72 flights, and the rover’s collection of rock samples. Readers can learn about these discoveries through short chapters and visual content.

The main benefits are making space science easier to understand, increasing interest in STEM subjects, and encouraging young readers to explore science. Our intended impact is to inspire curiosity about space, robotics, and future scientific discoveries.

We used Canva to design and create the digital book and ChatGPT to support writing and organizing the content. We also researched NASA’s official websites and used real mission information and images. No special hardware or coding language was required.

Our project is creative because it presents real scientific discoveries through an imaginative story. While developing it, our team considered scientific accuracy, age-appropriate language, visual design, readability, and the use of reliable sources.
